signal: VertexOne launched VXconnect, a modern customer engagement engine for energy and utility providers, and is leaning into utility CX

email.body1:
Cole, saw VertexOne launched VXconnect to modernize how utilities engage their customers.

A new flagship product usually opens more in-market utility accounts than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for VertexOne off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cole, quick follow-up on VertexOne's pipeline.

With VXconnect to push, the pipeline target climbs faster than the BD team can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many utility meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings VertexOne needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Cole, last bit of proof for VertexOne.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how VertexOne's reply rate likely compares to other utility-tech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Cole, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right as a new product ramps, and I know building utility coverage is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a utility-tech motion? I will tailor it to VertexOne either way.
